Expanding your commercial fleet shouldn’t require compromising your operational liquidity. With the Drive Now, Pay Later program at Rechtien International Trucks, your business can access 90-day no payment financing on eligible commercial trucks. By pushing your initial payment back three months, you can deploy new or pre-owned vehicles into your operations immediately. This structure allows your equipment to generate revenue and build positive momentum on the road long before your first invoice is due.
How 90-Day Deferred Commercial Financing Boosts Your Cash Flow

Acquiring new haulers, yard tractors, or medium-duty box trucks often presents a significant upfront cost. Standard commercial loans often require immediate monthly payments, which can strain working capital before a new vehicle becomes fully integrated into your delivery schedules.
